messages:
Alex CSM: Heads-up: Kestrel Health asked for a 90m enablement workshop next week (about 20 attendees). They mentioned adoption gaps and signaled potential renewal risk. Need to finalize agenda, prework, and a demo that highlights migration value. @Maya Enable could you lead? @Ian Ops need you on infra/demo prep.
Maya Enable: I can lead. Proposed agenda: 1) 25m platform intro + value metrics, 2) 35m hands-on migration demo (steps + sample data), 3) 20m ops: canary routing + KV cache warm-up, 4) 10m live Q&A. Add optional 15m follow-up office hours for hands-on troubleshooting.
Ian Ops: Sounds good. I'll reserve a Dedicated pool for the demo and run an infra pre-check. Need a test account and sample dataset from the customer. Also recommend we demo canary routing and fallback to hosted API.
Sophie Product: Add a short "rollback & SLA fallback" slide to calm exec concerns. Showing a runbook and a quick rollback demo helps renewal discussions.
Alex CSM: Maya, can you draft a 2-3 question prework survey to surface blockers and current infra? I'll outreach to confirm attendee timezones.
Maya Enable: Drafted prework survey (internal link): https://redwood.co/surveys/kestrel-prework. Proposed UTC slots: 2026-03-30 16:00, 2026-03-31 09:00, 2026-04-01 13:00. Calendar poll created.
calendar-bot: Poll created: https://calendar.redwood.co/polls/xyz789 4c5 React to vote or use the poll link.
Ian Ops: I'll take 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC. Can we block 1 hour before for prep? Please run: `/calendar block 2026-03-31T08:00-09:00Z prep:canary-demo`
Alex CSM: Invite should include: prework link, sample dataset S3 path, renewal health slide deck. @Sophie Product please provide the deck.
Sophie Product: Uploaded draft deck: drive/shared/kestrel/renewal_deck_v1.pdf. Will add rollback & SLA slide after Maya's agenda.
Maya Enable: We're requesting logs access from the customer; opened ticket CS-4892 for log access and dev keys. We'll demo KV cache warm-up and a canary traffic example.
Ian Ops: Presenter checklist for demo: confirm VPN access, upload test dataset, rotate demo keys, pre-warm Dedicated pool, add runbook link to invite. I'll paste checklist into the prep calendar event.
Alex CSM: We'll run a short anonymous pulse at the end for renewal signal: 3 quick questions (ease, confidence, intent). Keep it optional and 1-click.
Maya Enable: Proposed pulse questions: 1) Confidence to proceed (1-5), 2) Primary blocker, 3) Request follow-up session? I'll wire a quick Google form.
Alex CSM: Please confirm availability by EOD 2026-03-27. React with :+1: if you can present or propose an alternate. Customer timeline is tight.
Maya Enable: :+1: happy to lead.
Ian Ops: :+1: will handle infra + prep block.
Sophie Product: :+1: will finalize deck slides.
